findings.summary: Reordering Small first means a no-JavaScript browser would implicitly select Small before the page populates from config.
findings.detail: No option carries a selected attribute, so the browser selects the first option (Small) before the pageshow handler runs. src/ArrTags/Configuration/config.html:692 always sets #rendererSize from config.Renderer.Size during populate and line 799 always reads the select on submit, so the persisted and rendered value is unaffected. ADR-027 clause 3 mandates this exact order, so the behavior is required rather than a defect; the worker recorded the same interpretation.
findings.recommended_action: None; the ADR-mandated order is implemented and the round-trip path is unchanged.

findings.summary: Label spelling differs between surfaces (README 'ExtraLarge', architecture/configuration 'Extra Large').
findings.detail: README.md uses the enum token ExtraLarge while docs/architecture/09 and docs/data-model/03-12 use the human label Extra Large. This is a cosmetic precision inconsistency, not a correctness defect; the enum member name and the UI label are correctly distinguished throughout.
findings.recommended_action: Optional wording alignment if desired; not required for 18.1.
